summary:
Frontend-only end-to-end UI test of the new Go Perks Admin → Emails area (owner admin@tinysvouchers.com.au). Everything specified in the brief works and all cleanup was completed.

1) Nav + list: admin-nav-emails visible in the desktop side menu. /admin/emails renders admin-emails-page and template-list with all 5 group headers (Member invites, Partner pitches, Emails to members, Emails to partners, Emails to you) and all 12 expected template items (invite, pitch, welcome, renewal, gift, partner_welcome, deal_approved, deal_rejected, business_rejected, partner_report, new_applicant, weekly_digest). template-add-invite and template-add-pitch show under their groups.

2) Editor: Clicking template-item-deal_approved loads template-editor with template-subject-input / template-heading-input / template-intro-input / template-bullets-input / template-outro-input / template-button-input prefilled with the real template. All 4 layout tiles template-layout-classic/banner/letter/dark render and are clickable; selecting banner shows template-banner-input, switching away hides it. template-help lists the fill-in codes (brand + template vars).

3) Live preview: template-preview iframe + template-preview-subject update ~500–1500 ms after editing any text field OR switching layout. Verified subject changes from 'Your deal is live on {brand}' → 'TEST_UI Subject <ts>' after typing.

4) Save + persistence: template-save-btn → toast 'Template saved'. The sidebar button for deal_approved now reads 'Deal approvededited' (edited tag visible). Full reload → subject still 'TEST_UI Subject <ts>' confirming DB persistence.

5) Reset to original: template-reset-btn (with confirm dialog) restores the exact original subject 'Your deal is live on {brand}' and heading. Verified on BOTH deal_approved and weekly_digest, then confirmed via /api that no built-in template is 'edited' anymore.

6) New versions: template-add-pitch (prompt) created 2 custom pitch versions → appear as template-item-pitch-<hash>. template-name-input appears in the editor for customs; renamed 'TEST_UI Pitch A' → 'TEST_UI Pitch A Renamed' and saved. template-add-invite works identically. Delete via template-reset-btn (now rendered as 'Delete') removes custom versions from the list.

7) PitchDialog integration: Created a TEST_ prospect, ticked prospects-select-<id>, opened prospects-bulk-pitch → pitch-dialog opened; with 2+ pitch versions in the DB, pitch-template-select renders with 3 options (built-in + 2 custom). Switching option updates the template key sent to the preview endpoint (preview subject stays 'Free to join: put [Business name] in front of local Go Perks members' because freshly-created customs inherit the built-in wording — correct behaviour, not a defect). (First run of this check falsely reported the select missing; it was a 400 ms debounce timing issue — re-run with 2.5 s wait confirmed the select renders correctly.)

8) InviteComposer integration: /admin/invites shows invite-template-select with 2 options ('Member invite' built-in + 'TEST_UI Invite Mums' custom) when a custom invite version exists.

9) Responsive: At 390×844 the list stacks above the editor (template-list bottom 928.5 ≤ template-editor top 948.5, preview width 358 px, fully readable, no horizontal overflow). admin-mnav-emails is rendered inside the mobile hamburger drawer (prefix 'admin-mnav' per AdminShell.jsx L95). At 1440×900 the grid is the designed 260 px list + flexible editor + preview column.

SAFETY / CLEANUP: Every template edited (deal_approved, weekly_digest) was reset to original and verified via /api/admin/email-templates (0 edited built-ins remaining). All 3 custom pitch versions + 1 custom invite version created during testing were deleted (0 custom templates remaining). TEST_UI_EmailProspect_* and TEST_UI_SelProspect_* were deleted (prospects total back to the baseline 65, 0 TEST_ rows remaining). No real email was ever sent.
critical_code_review_comments: TemplateSelect.jsx returns null when opts.length < 2, meaning the dropdown is intentionally hidden when only the built-in version exists — matches the brief ('When 2+ pitch versions exist').
TemplateEditor Preview useEffect correctly debounces 400 ms on both key change and form change; preview subject updates reliably.
EmailsPage addVersion prompts with a sensible default name and immediately selects the new key — good UX.

TemplateEditor.remove reuses template-reset-btn for both 'Reset to original' (built-in) and 'Delete' (custom) — clean, but reviewers of the testid should be aware the same element has two semantics depending on t.custom.

Freshly created custom pitch/invite versions inherit the built-in's subject/body wording on the server, so the live preview looks identical to the built-in until the operator edits the new version. This is by design; worth calling out in the UI help so operators don't think the switch is broken.
GROUPS in EmailsPage.jsx uses positional arrays [label, filter, base]; a tiny refactor to objects would make it more maintainable but is not a defect.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (previous iter reports 126 backend tests passing)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — 12/12 template keys visible, save/reset/persistence verified on 2 built-ins, add/rename/delete verified on 2 pitch + 1 invite custom versions, pitch-template-select + invite-template-select integrations verified end-to-end, mobile layout verified

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created: 3 custom pitch versions ('TEST_UI Pitch A' renamed to 'TEST_UI Pitch A Renamed', 'TEST_UI Pitch B', 'TEST_UI PitchSel A', 'TEST_UI PitchSel B'), 1 custom invite version ('TEST_UI Invite Mums'), 2 TEST_UI_* prospects at Yarraville 3013. ALL deleted at end of run (verified: 0 custom templates, 0 edited built-ins, 0 TEST_ prospects, prospects total = 65).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new testids verified in UI: admin-nav-emails, admin-emails-page, template-list, template-item-<key> (for 12 built-in keys + dynamic template-item-pitch-<hash> / template-item-invite-<hash> for customs), template-editor, template-subject-input/heading-input/intro-input/bullets-input/outro-input/button-input, template-layouts with template-layout-classic|banner|letter|dark, template-banner-input (only when layout===banner), template-help, template-name-input (only for custom), template-save-btn, template-reset-btn (dual semantics: Reset for built-ins, Delete for customs), template-preview + template-preview-subject (iframe sandbox=''), template-add-invite, template-add-pitch. Integrations: pitch-template-select inside pitch-dialog (requires ≥2 pitch templates total and a ~1–2 s wait after dialog open because TemplateSelect fetches /admin/email-templates and renders null until opts.length≥2 — budget at least 2.5 s wait before asserting). invite-template-select inside /admin/invites composer (same rule). Reset confirm uses window.confirm — page.once('dialog', d: d.accept()) before clicking template-reset-btn. All API cleanup endpoints available: DELETE /api/admin/email-templates/<key> works for both built-ins (resets to original, returns the template) and customs (deletes, returns 200).
rca of the issue: No defects. The feature matches the brief: (a) /admin/emails is owner-only with a 260 px grouped sidebar + 2-column editor/preview split; (b) every template has 6 editable text fields + 4 layout tiles + optional banner URL with a sandboxed iframe live preview debounced at 400 ms; (c) Save persists to DB (reload-verified) and tags built-ins as 'edited'; (d) Reset to original on built-ins restores the shipped wording byte-for-byte (verified for deal_approved and weekly_digest); (e) 'New version' prompts for a name and creates a custom key that is fully editable/renameable/deletable; (f) when ≥2 pitch versions exist, PitchDialog surfaces pitch-template-select; when ≥2 invite versions exist InviteComposer surfaces invite-template-select; (g) 390 px layout stacks list above editor with a readable 358 px preview column. Earlier iteration-9 regression surface (prospects, suburb picker, map, follow-up) was not re-tested per the instructions but was unchanged by this feature.
